lines.zh: 腹足粘住叶面，一缩一伸。
lines.en: My prolegs stick to the leaf; I contract and stretch.
My prolegs grip the leaf's edge.
I crawl slowly along the vein.

lines.zh: 我身下就是我唯一的路。
lines.en: Under me is my only road.

lines.zh: 我抬头探了探下一片叶。
lines.en: I stretch up to test the next leaf.
Off a leaf, I starve.
I won't stray a step.
My segments bunch and stretch.
I go around a chewed hole.
I keep to the leaf's underside; the light's too strong.
I poke my head out and pull it back.

lines.zh: 一片叶子吃了一半，我挪窝。
lines.en: Half a leaf eaten; I move on.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶爬到那一片。
lines.en: I crawl from this leaf to that one.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可我一直在走。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never stop.
I have many feet, all of them short.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶柄那里，犹豫了。
lines.en: At the stem I hesitate.
I lie in the leaf's heart, motionless.
I chew slowly at a corner of leaf.
I curl my body into a ring.
Sun through the leaf comes out green.
I lift my head and see nothing.

lines.zh: 我把前半个身子抬起来。
lines.en: I raise my front half.
A gust and the leaf sways hard.
I hold tight and don't let go.

lines.zh: 我在量下一片叶有多远。
lines.en: I'm judging how far the next leaf is.
Ring after ring marks my skin.
A bird calls nearby.
I tuck my head under the leaf.
You're far too big.
I lift my head and freeze.

lines.zh: 你的影子把叶子压暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow darkens the leaf.

lines.zh: 我靠近了叶柄，能躲就躲。
lines.en: I edge toward the stem, just in case.
Where do you want to move me?
I've only got this one leaf.
My body is tightening.
Your finger is very close.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我只会吃叶子。
lines.en: I don't bite; I only eat leaves.

lines.zh: 我蜷到叶脉根，尽量占小地方。
lines.en: I curl to the vein's base and take up as little as I can.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩成紧紧的环。
lines.en: I curl into a tight ring.
I shrink up in pain.
One of my segments has split.
I crawl to the underside.
My prolegs slipped once.
I slowly uncurl again.
It hurts, but I can still hold on.
I make no sound; I just stop.
I retreat from the edge to the middle.
I don't want to move again.
Leaf! It smells fresh.
Is that for me?
Toward the tender leaf, I rub forward an inch at a time.
This one's tenderer than mine.
One bite — it's soft.
I've eaten half of this one; leave it.
I gnaw along the edge.
The underside is sweeter.
This will keep me going a while.
Put the leaf at my mouth, or I can't reach.

lines.zh: 叶子一抖，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: The leaf jolts and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我抓住叶缘，荡了一会儿。
lines.en: I grip the edge and dangle.
You touched me; I'm soft.
I've been crowded to the leaf's tip.

lines.zh: 被挤到叶柄，我卷成紧紧的环。
lines.en: Squeezed to the petiole, I coil into a tight ring.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的叶子扯破了。
lines.en: That tore my leaf.
I'm at the torn edge — dangerous.
I creep back to the middle.

lines.zh: 你手指压下来，我软得没法挣。
lines.en: Your finger presses down and I'm too soft to push back.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶掉到了下一片。
lines.en: I fell from one leaf onto the next.
Another one is on the leaf too.

lines.zh: 两条软身子沿叶缘对着啃。
lines.en: Two soft bodies chew toward each other along the leaf edge.
I touch its head and it doesn't shrink.

lines.zh: 我们把叶子吃出一个圆洞。
lines.en: Between us we eat a round hole.
It crawls slowly; I keep pace.
Two soft bodies pressed together.
This leaf isn't finished; eat slowly.
At night we lean like this.
It moves on; I follow.

lines.zh: 明天也许我就要结蛹了。
lines.en: Tomorrow, maybe, I'll spin a chrysalis.
I take hold of the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 人把我从一片叶搬到另一片。
lines.en: Someone moved me leaf to leaf.

lines.zh: 人被拎起来，我还咬着叶边。
lines.en: Lifted up, I still bite the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 这一块叶子被我咬下来了。
lines.en: I've bitten this piece off.
My mouth is full of leaf.
That one's dead; I won't eat it.
I rub against the leaf.
I've caught a thin stem.
Too old a leaf; too tough.

lines.zh: 叶尖太滑，我用丝吊住自己。
lines.en: The leaf tip is slick; I hang myself from silk.
The leaf ahead is moving.
I lift my head and pose as a shoot.
That thing isn't a leaf.

lines.zh: 我贴住叶面，连毛都伏下。
lines.en: I press to the leaf, even my bristles flattened.
This leaf is all I have.
I'm getting ready to curl.
I crawl to the underside.
It is about to come over.

lines.zh: 叶面一暗，我把头抬起来。
lines.en: The leaf dims; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我把嚼叶的口器也停了。
lines.en: I even stop the mouthparts chewing.
I go around along the leaf's edge.
It circles; I retreat to the stem.
I make myself smaller.
It's on the other side of the leaf.
I stay still and wait for it to leave.
I press my head under the leaf.
I listen to the leaf rustle.
I hide under the chewed hole.
Only a chewed patch is left on the leaf's back.
I inch my way out.

lines.zh: 我用头顶了一下，立刻缩回。
lines.en: I butt with my head, then pull straight back.
I shove it with my head.
I bite — not to eat.

lines.zh: 我把整个前半身甩过去。
lines.en: I swing my whole front half at it.
It backed off and I crawl back.
I curl into a ring.
I flick my front half.
I've fallen below.
It didn't catch me.
I caught the leaf and didn't drop far.
I work my way out of the eggshell.
Leaves on every side.
My first mouthful is leaf.
My body is still damp.
I creep to the middle of the leaf.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳钻出，身边全是叶。
lines.en: I chew out of the egg with leaves all around.
I stretch out to gauge the distance.
When the wind blows I grip.
The leaf is a bit old, but edible.
This leaf is where I'll stay.

lines.zh: 叶子先燃起来，我跟着烫。
lines.en: The leaf burns first, then I do.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，一直掉很远。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf, a long way down.
A drop of water swallows me whole.

lines.zh: 叶子被炸碎，我跟着飞出去。
lines.en: The leaf bursts and I fly with it.

lines.zh: 有什么尖东西擦过了我。
lines.en: Something sharp grazed me.
My body is tightening on its own.

lines.zh: 这片叶子吃完了，我没得去。
lines.en: This leaf is finished and I've nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 雷光闪过，我的身体都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 叶子没了，我一直往下坠。
lines.en: The leaf is gone and I'm falling.
